summary: Frontend regression testing for iteration_53: (a) React.lazy + Suspense route code-splitting refactor, (b) hero image swap to self-hosted /images/hero-bg.webp, (c) new legacyBlogRedirects React Router redirect map for 7 blog slugs with periods. All 14 tested routes load with correct titles and no stuck loading fallback. Hero image serves 200 OK (61,818 bytes / ~62KB webp). React Router SPA redirect verified working (pushState + popstate to an old slug → URL rewrites to new dash-only slug on preview domain and article title 'The Average Data Breach Now Costs $4.88 Million...' renders). Backend API confirmed: new slug 200, old slug 404 (correct). Direct URL entry to an old slug triggers the static meta-refresh stub (SEO fallback, points to production domain absolute canonical URL - this is by design per the review request). No new console errors introduced by the refactor beyond the pre-existing 'Unexpected token <' pageerror already tracked in iteration_49/50/52.
critical_code_review_comments: Static meta-refresh stubs in /public/resources/<old-slug>/index.html point to https://www.veracitytechmn.com (production absolute URL). On the preview deployment, direct hits to an old-slug URL therefore bounce the user off the preview and onto production. This is fine for real end-users hitting production directly, and matches the pattern used for the 45 legacy city stubs, but is worth noting: preview cannot be used to smoke-test the old-slug direct-hit path end-to-end - only the React Router SPA path and the new-slug direct path stay on preview.

The React Router legacyBlogRedirects logic in BlogPost/index.jsx (line 96-98) only fires after the API returns not-found for the requested slug. Since old-slug in-app links are unlikely (posts have been renamed), the primary consumers of this redirect are external inbound links / bookmarks - which are handled by the static meta-refresh stub, not this code path. Both mechanisms are in place, so this is defense-in-depth, not a bug.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth on this site
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL (veracity-ai-managed.preview.emergentagent.com) is serving the built/prerendered static site, not the dev server. The review note claimed dev-server hot reload but tests show CF/prerender is serving compiled artifacts (meta-refresh stubs served for legacy blog paths, all routes prerendered as .html). This did NOT affect testing of the lazy-loading refactor because the built bundle already includes the code-split chunks. If future testing needs live hot-reload behavior, verify via curl -I whether the server serves index.html or the prerendered per-route .html. Pre-existing 'Unexpected token <' pageerror is a non-JS asset returning HTML (likely a stray script src); tracked but non-blocking since iteration_49.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration. All three change sets (route lazy-loading, hero image compression, legacyBlogRedirects) verified working. Code-split main bundle (~296KB gzipped) plus ~20 route chunks confirmed by build output; runtime confirmed by successful navigation to all 14 route types without a stuck [data-testid='route-loading-fallback'].
